images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone landscape 16:9 in-game environment concept screenshot for TANKUS, a bright friendly 3D toy tank party combat game in Godot. Create one complete image, not a collage. Plausible polished indie realtime 3D graphics: simple bevelled low-poly geometry, clean PBR surfaces, soft sunny shadows and clear saturated blue sky. NOT photorealistic, NOT a gritty military base. Map concept RADIO STATION: compact open-air rectangular arena approximately 60 by 48 metres. Layout is two interconnected side courtyards separated by a long narrow SOLID central raised service terrace 12m wide and 22m long, 3m above ground. Terrace has TWO broad vehicle RAMPS at diagonally opposing ends, each 6m wide and 8m long. Broad ground-level flanking loops connect both courtyards around the north and south ends of the terrace; no single choke point. A modest antenna equipment pedestal on the centre terrace provides hard cover, with at least 4m clearance beside it. A large friendly sculptural broadcasting aerial or satellite antenna on that pedestal is the main landmark; tall antenna parts are elevated above tank height, do not form a tall solid wall or obstruct all sightlines. Several staggered L-shaped low equipment barriers and simple electronics cabinets break up each side courtyard, 1.5-2m tall, with broad 5-7m vehicle lanes between them. Keep eight peripheral spawn pockets conceivable; no spawn labels. No roofs across drivable space, no tunnels, no stairs on mandatory routes, no narrow catwalks, no labyrinth, no giant central skyscraper, no hazards that require special abilities. Small cobalt-blue toy scout tank prominent foreground, angular blue enamel hull, separate rotating turret with a short cannon, cyan optic, small yellow accents, black rubber tracks with three wheels on each side, tank width approximately 2m. One or two red enemy toy tanks in middle distance provide scale. Keep battlefield readable, effects restrained. No text, no labels, no HUD, no logo, no watermark. This is a visualization of a proposed game environment, not an actual engine screenshot. Art direction A: SUNLIT RETRO BROADCAST STATION. Warm cream concrete, bold orange enamel equipment housings, teal trim and a few yellow cable conduits. A white parabolic satellite dish mounted on a compact orange antenna pedestal, dish points up and outwards. Rounded rectangular radio cabinets and cream L-shaped barriers offer cover in both side courtyards. Ground is clean pale concrete with restrained orange and teal painted lane markings, no ceramic garden motifs. A few green shrubs confined to perimeter planters. Distant gentle green hills beyond a low perimeter wall. Camera: real third-person chase view about 9m behind the foreground blue tank and slightly above its turret, moderate downward pitch, horizon visible, 68 degree FOV. Look diagonally across one side courtyard toward the central antenna terrace and the broad ramp leading up to it, see another courtyard through the open end route. Inviting bright midday colors, toy-like solid shapes.
